findings.title: Hearing falsehood meets a stripping intake
findings.claim: The paired focus predicates let attentive hearing of falsehood touch an appetite that consumes in a stripping mode, so reception becomes an opening through which a gain that removes protection can proceed.
findings.mechanism: The focus form سَمَّاعُونَ carries purposeful listening when it is joined to لِلْكَذِبِ, while أَكَّالُونَ لِلسُّحْتِ supplies the adjacent consuming relation and the registered root_000681/B001 stripping facet. The two focus words therefore explain one another as an intake that passes from hearing into removal.
findings.reader_payoff: False listening becomes perceptible as a participating intake rather than a neutral sound, and the gain is seen as something that can strip what ought to remain protected.
findings.containment: The fixed 'duyulsun ama bana ulaşmasın' saying in root_000741/B011 is excluded because its form is absent here. This finding retains ordinary attentive hearing and the stripping image as a bounded focus relation; it does not redefine the whole ayah or claim that the fixed non-arrival wish is present.

epistemic.reason: A trusted cross-run publication anchors the two-word relation, but its hearing branch required form-sensitive narrowing; the surviving ordinary-listening and stripping contact is explicitly bounded.

findings.title: Qist as calibrated remedy

findings.mechanism: The focus supplies corrective restraint in the judging form and two registered qist facets, due portion and straight balance. The exact HFT trace returns through those focus words from attributed context roles for deterrent sanction, repair, matched response, and voluntary yielding of a claim, which together turn generic fairness into a measured remedy relation.
findings.reader_payoff: Justice becomes perceptible as a way of measuring and stopping a response, with repair and release still possible after the harm has been addressed.
findings.containment: The HFT record marks the calibration arrow as an inference and keeps a live alternative that 5:38, 5:39, and 5:45 are separate legal cases. The unresolved context branches are attributed roles only; this finding does not claim that qist lexically names every sanction, repair, equivalence, or remission detail.

epistemic.reason: Exact focus and context coordinates, Arabic anchors, and HFT roles are supplied, while the synthesis that they jointly calibrate qist is explicitly inferential and the unresolved branches have no independent lexicon records.
